feature_queries.name: user_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       date_diff('day', u.CreationDate, e.Timestamp) AS account_age_days,
       (u.WebsiteUrl IS NOT NULL) AS has_website,
       (u.Location IS NOT NULL) AS has_location,
       (u.AboutMe IS NOT NULL) AS has_about
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN Users u ON u.Id = e.Id

feature_queries.name: posts_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         COUNT(p.Id) AS posts_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_7d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 1 AND p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 2 AND p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_30d,
         MAX(p.CreationDate) AS last_post_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT Id, Timestamp,
       posts_all_time, posts_7d, posts_30d, posts_90d,
       questions_all_time, answers_all_time,
       questions_30d, answers_30d,
       date_diff('day', last_post_ts, Timestamp) AS days_since_last_post,
       COALESCE(answers_all_time,0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_all_time,0) AS answer_share,
       COALESCE(COALESCE(answers_30d,0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_30d,0), 0.0) AS answer_share_30d
FROM p

feature_queries.name: comments_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         COUNT(c.Id) AS comments_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_7d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d,
         AVG(c.Score) AS avg_comment_score,
         MAX(c.CreationDate) AS last_comment_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Comments c
    ON c.UserId = e.Id
   AND c.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT Id, Timestamp,
       comments_all_time, comments_7d, comments_30d, comments_90d,
       avg_comment_score,
       date_diff('day', last_comment_ts, Timestamp) AS days_since_last_comment
FROM c

feature_queries.name: post_cadence
feature_queries.sql:
WITH recent_posts AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, p.CreationDate,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Id, e.Timestamp ORDER BY p.CreationDate DESC) AS rn
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
), piv AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN CreationDate END) AS post_last_ts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN CreationDate END) AS post_prev_ts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN CreationDate END) AS post_prev2_ts
  FROM recent_posts
  WHERE rn <= 3
  GROUP BY Id, Timestamp
)
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       date_diff('day', piv.post_last_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_post2,
       date_diff('day', piv.post_prev_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_prev_post,
       date_diff('day', piv.post_prev2_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_prev2_post,
       date_diff('day', piv.post_prev_ts, piv.post_last_ts) AS gap_last_prev_post_days,
       date_diff('day', piv.post_prev2_ts, piv.post_prev_ts) AS gap_prev_prev2_post_days
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN piv ON piv.Id=e.Id AND piv.Timestamp=e.Timestamp

feature_queries.name: activity_cadence
feature_queries.sql:
WITH acts AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, p.CreationDate AS act_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, c.CreationDate AS act_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Comments c
    ON c.UserId = e.Id
   AND c.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Id, Timestamp ORDER BY act_ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM acts
), piv AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN act_ts END) AS act_last_ts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN act_ts END) AS act_prev_ts,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN act_ts END) AS act_prev2_ts
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 3
  GROUP BY Id, Timestamp
)
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       date_diff('day', piv.act_last_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_activity,
       date_diff('day', piv.act_prev_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_prev_activity,
       date_diff('day', piv.act_prev2_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_prev2_activity,
       date_diff('day', piv.act_prev_ts, piv.act_last_ts) AS gap_last_prev_activity_days,
       date_diff('day', piv.act_prev2_ts, piv.act_prev_ts) AS gap_prev_prev2_activity_days
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN piv ON piv.Id=e.Id AND piv.Timestamp=e.Timestamp

feature_queries.name: badges_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         COUNT(b.Id) AS badges_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_badges_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS silver_badges_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bronze_badges_all_time,
         MAX(b.Date) AS last_badge_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Badges b
    ON b.UserId = e.Id
   AND b.Date < e.Timestamp
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT Id, Timestamp,
       badges_all_time, badges_90d,
       gold_badges_all_time, silver_badges_all_time, bronze_badges_all_time,
       date_diff('day', last_badge_ts, Timestamp) AS days_since_last_badge
FROM b

feature_queries.name: vote_post_interactions
feature_queries.sql:
WITH vp AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         COUNT(v.Id) AS votes_received_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_received_7d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_received_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_received_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received_all_time,
         MAX(v.CreationDate) AS last_vote_received_ts
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  LEFT JOIN Vote v
    ON v.PostId = p.Id
   AND v.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT Id, Timestamp,
       votes_received_all_time, votes_received_7d, votes_received_30d, votes_received_90d,
       upvotes_received_all_time, downvotes_received_all_time,
       date_diff('day', last_vote_received_ts, Timestamp) AS days_since_last_vote_received,
       COALESCE(downvotes_received_all_time,0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(upvotes_received_all_time + downvotes_received_all_time,0) AS downvote_received_rate
FROM vp

feature_queries.name: user_tags_365d_allposts
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base_posts AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, p.Id AS PostId, p.PostTypeId, p.ParentId
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
   AND p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
), question_posts AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp, PostId AS QId
  FROM base_posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Id, Timestamp, ParentId AS QId
  FROM base_posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 2 AND ParentId IS NOT NULL
), tag_counts AS (
  SELECT qp.Id, qp.Timestamp, pt.TagId, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM question_posts qp
  JOIN PostTag pt ON pt.PostId = qp.QId
  GROUP BY qp.Id, qp.Timestamp, pt.TagId
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Id, Timestamp ORDER BY n DESC, TagId) AS rn
  FROM tag_counts
), top_tag AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN TagId END) AS top_tag_id_365d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN n END) AS top_tag_cnt_365d
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY Id, Timestamp
), distinct_tag AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp, COUNT(DISTINCT TagId) AS distinct_tags_365d
  FROM tag_counts
  GROUP BY Id, Timestamp
)
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       COALESCE(d.distinct_tags_365d, 0) AS distinct_tags_365d,
       t.top_tag_id_365d,
       COALESCE(t.top_tag_cnt_365d, 0) AS top_tag_cnt_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN distinct_tag d ON d.Id = e.Id AND d.Timestamp = e.Timestamp
LEFT JOIN top_tag t ON t.Id = e.Id AND t.Timestamp = e.Timestamp

feature_queries.name: postlink_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH user_posts AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, p.Id AS PostId
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
), pl_in AS (
  SELECT up.Id, up.Timestamp,
         COUNT(pl.Id) AS links_in_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.CreationDate >= up.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_in_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.CreationDate >= up.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_in_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.LinkTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_in_type1_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.LinkTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_in_type3_all_time,
         MAX(pl.CreationDate) AS last_link_in_ts
  FROM user_posts up
  JOIN PostLink pl
    ON pl.RelatedPostId = up.PostId
   AND pl.CreationDate < up.Timestamp
  GROUP BY up.Id, up.Timestamp
), pl_out AS (
  SELECT up.Id, up.Timestamp,
         COUNT(pl.Id) AS links_out_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.CreationDate >= up.Timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_out_30d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.CreationDate >= up.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_out_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.LinkTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_out_type1_all_time,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.LinkTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS links_out_type3_all_time,
         MAX(pl.CreationDate) AS last_link_out_ts
  FROM user_posts up
  JOIN PostLink pl
    ON pl.PostId = up.PostId
   AND pl.CreationDate < up.Timestamp
  GROUP BY up.Id, up.Timestamp
)
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       COALESCE(i.links_in_all_time,0) AS links_in_all_time,
       COALESCE(i.links_in_30d,0) AS links_in_30d,
       COALESCE(i.links_in_90d,0) AS links_in_90d,
       COALESCE(i.links_in_type1_all_time,0) AS links_in_type1_all_time,
       COALESCE(i.links_in_type3_all_time,0) AS links_in_type3_all_time,
       date_diff('day', i.last_link_in_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_link_in,
       COALESCE(o.links_out_all_time,0) AS links_out_all_time,
       COALESCE(o.links_out_30d,0) AS links_out_30d,
       COALESCE(o.links_out_90d,0) AS links_out_90d,
       COALESCE(o.links_out_type1_all_time,0) AS links_out_type1_all_time,
       COALESCE(o.links_out_type3_all_time,0) AS links_out_type3_all_time,
       date_diff('day', o.last_link_out_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_link_out
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN pl_in i ON i.Id=e.Id AND i.Timestamp=e.Timestamp
LEFT JOIN pl_out o ON o.Id=e.Id AND o.Timestamp=e.Timestamp

feature_queries.name: answer_parent_features_windowed
feature_queries.sql:
WITH answers AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp, a.Id AS AnswerId, a.ParentId AS QId, a.CreationDate
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN Posts a
    ON a.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND a.PostTypeId = 2
   AND a.ParentId IS NOT NULL
   AND a.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
   AND a.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
), parent_q AS (
  SELECT Id, Timestamp, QId
  FROM answers
  GROUP BY Id, Timestamp, QId
), q_votes AS (
  SELECT pq.Id, pq.Timestamp,
         COUNT(v.Id) AS parent_q_votes_365d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= pq.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS parent_q_votes_90d,
         MAX(v.CreationDate) AS last_parent_q_vote_ts
  FROM parent_q pq
  JOIN Vote v
    ON v.PostId = pq.QId
   AND v.CreationDate < pq.Timestamp
   AND v.CreationDate >= pq.Timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
  GROUP BY pq.Id, pq.Timestamp
), q_links AS (
  SELECT pq.Id, pq.Timestamp,
         COUNT(pl.Id) AS parent_q_links_365d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pl.CreationDate >= pq.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS parent_q_links_90d,
         MAX(pl.CreationDate) AS last_parent_q_link_ts
  FROM parent_q pq
  JOIN PostLink pl
    ON (pl.PostId = pq.QId OR pl.RelatedPostId = pq.QId)
   AND pl.CreationDate < pq.Timestamp
   AND pl.CreationDate >= pq.Timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
  GROUP BY pq.Id, pq.Timestamp
), q_tags AS (
  SELECT pq.Id, pq.Timestamp,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pt.TagId) AS parent_q_distinct_tags_365d
  FROM parent_q pq
  JOIN PostTag pt ON pt.PostId = pq.QId
  GROUP BY pq.Id, pq.Timestamp
), ans_agg AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         COUNT(a.Id) AS answers_365d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_90d,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.ParentId) AS distinct_parent_q_365d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Posts a
    ON a.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND a.PostTypeId = 2
   AND a.ParentId IS NOT NULL
   AND a.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
   AND a.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days'
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
       COALESCE(ans_agg.answers_365d,0) AS answers_365d,
       COALESCE(ans_agg.answers_90d,0) AS answers_90d,
       COALESCE(ans_agg.distinct_parent_q_365d,0) AS distinct_parent_q_365d,
       COALESCE(qv.parent_q_votes_365d,0) AS parent_q_votes_365d,
       COALESCE(qv.parent_q_votes_90d,0) AS parent_q_votes_90d,
       date_diff('day', qv.last_parent_q_vote_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_parent_q_vote,
       COALESCE(ql.parent_q_links_365d,0) AS parent_q_links_365d,
       COALESCE(ql.parent_q_links_90d,0) AS parent_q_links_90d,
       date_diff('day', ql.last_parent_q_link_ts, e.Timestamp) AS days_since_last_parent_q_link,
       COALESCE(qt.parent_q_distinct_tags_365d,0) AS parent_q_distinct_tags_365d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN ans_agg ON ans_agg.Id=e.Id AND ans_agg.Timestamp=e.Timestamp
LEFT JOIN q_votes qv ON qv.Id=e.Id AND qv.Timestamp=e.Timestamp
LEFT JOIN q_links ql ON ql.Id=e.Id AND ql.Timestamp=e.Timestamp
LEFT JOIN q_tags qt ON qt.Id=e.Id AND qt.Timestamp=e.Timestamp

feature_queries.name: content_length_activity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH up AS (
  SELECT e.Id, e.Timestamp,
         AVG(LENGTH(p.Body)) AS avg_body_len_all,
         MAX(LENGTH(p.Body)) AS max_body_len_all,
         AVG(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN LENGTH(p.Body) END) AS avg_body_len_90d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN LENGTH(p.Body) END) AS max_body_len_90d,
         AVG(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 THEN LENGTH(p.Title) END) AS avg_title_len_all_q,
         AVG(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 AND p.CreationDate >= e.Timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN LENGTH(p.Title) END) AS avg_title_len_90d_q,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.Body IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(p.Id),0) AS frac_missing_body
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN Posts p
    ON p.OwnerUserId = e.Id
   AND p.CreationDate < e.Timestamp
  GROUP BY e.Id, e.Timestamp
)
SELECT * FROM up
